ios.desc:
Take control of your screen time and build healthier digital habits with ScreenBreak, your personal focus companion. Break free from endless scrolling and app overuse with our intelligent app blocking and focus-building features.

KEY FEATURES:
*** Customizable App Blocking ***

Create personalized blocking schedules for any app
Set daily usage limits with flexible launch counters
Configure blocking rules for specific days and hours
Mix and match different blocking strategies

*** Focus Challenges ***

Unique "unlock challenges" prevent mindless app access
Interactive mini-games that make you pause and think
Break the cycle of unconscious app opening
Build awareness of your app usage patterns

*** Detailed Usage Insights ***

Track your screen time with detailed daily breakdowns
Visualize your app usage hour by hour
Identify your most time-consuming apps
Understand your digital behavior patterns

*** Progress Tracking ***

Weekly progress reports to celebrate your improvements
Track your focus score over time
Monitor your success rate in reducing app overuse
Set and achieve personal digital wellness goals


ScreenBreak helps you:

Reduce social media addiction
Improve productivity and focus
Develop mindful app usage habits
Reclaim time for what matters most

Whether you're looking to boost productivity, reduce digital distractions, or simply create a healthier relationship with your device, ScreenBreak provides the tools you need to succeed.
Download ScreenBreak today and take the first step toward a more balanced digital life. Your future self will thank you.
Note: ScreenBreak requires screen time permissions to function properly.

PRIVACY POLICY

quotes.text:
Social media platforms are relentlessly optimizing their recommendation algorithms for engagement - and by extension, profit. While these algorithms excel at surfacing relevant content, they've also become incredibly effective at exploiting our cognitive vulnerabilities. What started as "let me check one video" now routinely turns into hours of doomscrolling. The algorithms have gotten too good at their job.

Apple's original screen time control is too simple - it allows +15 minutes infinitely and doesn't help much, at least for me. I tried several third-party screen time control apps, and some are quite good. As a programmer learning iOS development, I wanted to build something slightly different - yet another screen time control app that suits best to my personal needs. That's how ScreenBreak was born, with its focus challenges and more fine-grained analytics.

ScreenBreak introduces "focus challenges" - mini-games you must complete to access blocked apps. Want to check Instagram? Draw a perfect circle first. Need TikTok? Tap the screen 200 times in 60 seconds. After 5 minutes of usage, the app gets locked again, requiring another challenge to continue. These challenges are designed to be just annoying enough to break the dopamine loop, but engaging enough that users don't immediately uninstall the app. I'm actively building new challenges and exploring different ways to help people preserve their sanity while exploring social media content.
